text:
harper: Noticed a weird cluster of SSE reconnections during the EU canary rollout — keepalives showing jitter then immediate reconnects, some clients issuing duplicate resume frames. Small customer impact but reproducible.

drew: Which rollout? anything to do with the keepalive/tcp windows we changed?

harper: We toggled the keepalive probe frequency down to 250ms for faster failure detection. Replays show proxy sending a shorter keepalive and some clients immediately re-opening without waiting -> two resume attempts.

noah: Console traces (pasted to #eng-platform-logs) show a burst of midstream 204/early-close responses and a spike in "resume_attempts" metric. Sampling for resume spans was at 0.5% so only 3 traces captured. We should bump sampling immediately.

sylvia: Repro locally: long SSE -> flip keepalive freq -> client sees socket close -> client reconnects, sometimes sends resume twice. Script:```
# repro snippet
curl -N "https://api.redwood/v1/sse?cid=test-client" &
sleep 1
# flip keepalive to aggressive
curl -XPOST "https://console.internal/api/configs/set?key=proxy.keepalive_ms&value=250"
sleep 1
kill -HUP $!
sleep 2
```

drew: Quick mitigations: 1) revert keepalive to 1s for canary hosts, 2) add server-side short-window dedupe for resume (treat same sessionid+last_id within 2s as duplicate), 3) surface the keepalive change in the rollout timeline overlay so metrics correlate automatically. Revert is fastest.

harper: Ops wants an alert: if resume_attempts > 8/min AND resume_duplicate_rate > 0.5% then page SRE. Also bump resume span sampling to 10% for the next 12h.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Applying emergency config cfg-202499: proxy.keepalive_ms=1000, tracing.resume_sample=0.10 to eu-canary. Targets: 4 hosts. 2/4 updated.

noah: For billing safety, fallback routes appear fine (quota namespaces matched) but the double resume causes duplicate accounting on a small subset where resume was processed twice before dedupe. Implementing the 2s dedupe will stop the extra counts.

sylvia: UX request: console should show per-rollout annotations on the streaming dashboard (a small marker when config changes affecting connection semantics are rolled). Right now we have to manually correlate timestamps. Product likes the idea.

drew: Follow-ups: TRACK-220 add-resume-dedupe(2s), TRACK-221 rollout-annotation-on-streaming-dashboard, TRACK-222 auto-sample-on-route-change. Also add a short-term checkbox on rollouts: "boost-streaming-traces-for-24h".

harper: After cfg-202499 applied, reconnects normalized within ~80s and duplicate resume counts dropped by ~93%. Keeping resume sampling at 10% for 12h and will run a dry-run for dedupe logic in staging.

sylvia: I'll mock a small UI for rollout annotation and the boost checkbox. Adding a tooltip that explains "changing keepalive/backoff parameters may cause short reconnect flaps".

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: cfg-202499 fully applied. Change complete.

harper: Incident note: aggressive keepalive change in canary caused client immediate-reconnects and duplicate resume events; mitigated by reverting keepalive aggressiveness, adding sampling, and filing dedupe + dashboard annotation work. Minimal user impact. :thumbsup:
